equity.level_reason: Respondents are compared by provider type, region, years in practice and caseload, none of which is a social-position dimension; patient access to specialists is mentioned only as a general consequence in the Discussion.

level_alternative.reason: The Discussion notes a disadvantage for patients who face challenges seeking care or lack access to specialists, a generic equity mention.

notes: Group comparisons use chi-square p-values for each level vs a referent and an overall p-value per characteristic; region and provider type are not SPDs, so no groupwise entries. Table 1 CIs are reported without conclusions (CI method not stated).
view_issues: Table 1: 'Not too confident' CI 32.9–33.7 excludes its 35.3%; the '>5' row overlaps the 6–19, 20–100, >100 rows; resource rows labeled (865) use 1,500 as denominator (955, 63.7%). Text says 65% group practice; table shows 65.9%.
